title: After handcuff footage, ECB takes big call on Carse before Pakistan 2nd Test
content: England drop Brydon Carse from the second Test against Pakistan after footage shows the fast bowler in handcuffs outside a Derby nightclub. The Cricket Regulator is investigating the incident. Carse was reportedly released without charge after celebrating Durham’s County Championship win. The episode adds to recent disciplinary concerns involving England players following other nightclub-related incidents.

title: Surprise protests, GenZ outreach: Rahul Gandhi's new playbook after CJP's success
content: Rahul Gandhi’s political style has taken a more combative turn, with the Congress leader increasingly combining Gen Z outreach, parliamentary interventions and surprise street protests. From Bharat Jodo and Chhatron Ki Goonj to student protests and dharnas, the story looks at how Rahul is trying to stay with issues longer, while also navigating criticism.

title: Mark Zuckerberg’s wife Priscilla Chan’s $125 million school to shut after 10 years
content: After a decade of service, The Primary School, a free private institution, has officially closed its doors. This decision follows the conclusion of financial backing from the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative and the school's inability to meet state academic standards. As a result, approximately 540 students are set to transfer to the Ravenswood City Elementary School District, with the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative facilitating their transition and savings.

title: The Oval Obese: Trump's junk food habit crashes into MAHA crusade
content: President Trump's administration champions the importance of healthy eating and providing nutritious options to Americans. However, his fondness for fast food and sugary beverages presents a notable contradiction. This discrepancy weakens the central theme of the 'Make America Healthy Again' initiative. Health professionals emphasize that the president's weight warrants greater concern than his wardrobe, creating a dilemma for the administration in promoting healthy lifestyle choices effectively.

title: Pant breaks another record in Colombo, surpasses Gilchrist in six-hitting feat
content: In a phenomenal display of skill, Rishabh Pant has outshone Adam Gilchrist's Test six record, achieving an impressive 102 sixes over just 52 matches, positioning him third globally. Additionally, he has set a new benchmark as India's highest run-scorer among wicketkeepers in away Tests, surpassing MS Dhoni's previous record. Furthermore, Pant leads India in the World Test Championship run-scorer tally.

title: Mamdani’s team sends memo to ‘upset’ New Yorkers over million-dollar home tax
content: In a recent development, New York City's Finance Commissioner delivered a memo about the pied-à-terre tax that he could not present in person due to ongoing litigation. The memo specifies that the supplemental roll does not automatically create tax liabilities for property owners. To evade the surcharge, homeowners are encouraged to provide evidence of their primary residency. Notably, the deadline for lodging appeals has been broadened until September 18, 2026.

title: Nagpur chlorine leak horror: 56 hospitalised, 8 fighting for life in ICU
content: A chlorine gas leak at a Nagpur water treatment plant sent 56 residents to hospital. Eight patients remain in the ICU while 11 have been discharged. Emergency responders submerged the faulty chlorine tank to contain the dangerous gas. Health teams are conducting door-to-door checks for delayed symptoms. An inquiry is underway to determine the exact cause of the leakage.

title: Michigan couple bought farmhouse for $26,000, spent $320,000 restoring it
content: A Michigan couple bought an abandoned 160-year-old farmhouse for $26,000 and spent nearly $320,000 bringing it back to life. Samantha and Sean Kilgore tackled the massive restoration without professional renovation experience, transforming everything from the foundation to the kitchen. Their journey turned a neglected property into a beautiful home while preserving its history and character.

title: Perplexity, which wanted to buy Chrome, in talks with Nvidia for money
content: Perplexity, the AI search startup led by Aravind Srinivas that once made an unsolicited $34.5 billion bid for Google's Chrome browser, is now in talks with Nvidia for funding. The Information reports the round would value Perplexity above $30 billion, up more than 50 percent from its last valuation, as annualised revenue climbs past $750 million on the back of its Perplexity Computer agent.

title: Inside Cody Rhodes' luxurious lifestyle: homes, cars, watches and more
content: Cody Rhodes took his WWE success and made it a lifestyle of luxury and family, fitness and personal style. The American Nightmare has cultivated a unique public image, from fancy houses and a love for cars to custom suits and big watches, and the financial success that fuels his wrestling career is also seen in his disciplined routine and growing business profile.

title: Cooper Flagg's GF mistaken for Jahmyr Gibbs' as NFL WAGs pose for brand
content: In a funny mix-up, Arianna Roberson, girlfriend of basketball star Cooper Flagg, found herself mistaken for Jahmyr Gibbs online following a viral clip highlighting her with Flagg. Additionally, Jahmyr Gibbs’ girlfriend, Nicole Anderson, made headlines as she joined other NFL wives for a promotional shoot featuring OFF SEASON, a trendy clothing line set to lauch its Fall ‘26 collection.

title: Harper Beckham calls Victoria her "whole world" in emotional holiday post
content: Harper Beckham called her mother Victoria Beckham her “whole world” while sharing photos from the family’s Italian holiday. Victoria reposted the picture and replied with a loving message. David and Victoria continue travelling with Harper, while Romeo and Cruz have returned to the UK. Brooklyn Beckham remains absent as family tensions continue to attract attention.

title: US unleashes ‘Malice’: F-35C gets a 463-km air-to-air strike reach
content: The US Navy has introduced the AIM-424 missile, specifically engineered for the F-35C fighter jet. With a remarkable range exceeding 463 kilometers for air-to-air combat, this advanced missile maintains the aircraft's stealth attributes by allowing for internal carriage. The AIM-424 significantly boosts the F-35C's operational capabilities, while adversaries like Russia and China are rapidly advancing their own long-range missile programs.

title: Allahabad HC rejects Atiq Ahmed's eldest son Mohammad Umar's bail plea
content: The Allahabad High Court denied bail to Mohammad Umar, the eldest son of Atiq Ahmed, who is under serious allegations of extortion and threats stemming from a case filed in the previous year. Presently, he remains incarcerated in Lucknow jail. Meanwhile, his sibling Ali has been granted temporary parole for a burial, as the Atiq Ahmed family grapples with devastating losses since 2023.

title: India's 2026 Hockey WC semi-final race ends with 3-5 loss to Argentina
content: India’s men’s hockey team exit the 2026 World Cup semi-final race after losing 3-5 to Argentina. Two early goals put India on the back foot, while poor passing and missed penalty corners hurt their comeback hopes. Sukhjeet scores twice and Hardik adds a penalty stroke, but Argentina’s five-goal haul seals victory. India now play for seventh or eighth place.

title: From property registration to parking: What Karnataka’s 8 new Bills mean for you
content: Karnataka has passed eight new Bills that significantly influence property registration and land management in the state. These regulations will implement remote e-registration and bolster digital frameworks for property dealings. Unapproved rural properties must now comply with town planning guidelines. Additionally, park land can be designated for public utilities under strict oversight, while other Bills focus on refining commercial regulations and enhancing Bengaluru's transport system.

title: Infosys pays average 70% bonus for first quarter; staff await clarity on salary hikes
content: Infosys reported a 12% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 7,769 crore for the April-June quarter last month, even as it reduced its revenue growth guidance for the full year.

title: The unseen challenge behind every BWF World C'ships match schedule
content: The recently concluded BWF World Championships in New Delhi highlighted the complex task of scheduling elite badminton, as injuries, television demands and player recovery constantly reshaped the order of play. While Gayatri Gopichand and Treesa Jolly were rushed to court in an eventual win, France's Toma Junior Popov questioned uneven recovery time, exposing the delicate balance tournament referees must strike.

title: Kangana hits back at critics: BJP MP slams Sonu, Taapsee, Rakhi; calls Ramdev ‘failed’
content: Kangana Ranaut hit back at critics including Rakhi Sawant, Taapsee Pannu, Ashutosh Rana, Sonu Sood and Baba Ramdev, calling them "failed, stupid, and disgusting" for their remarks about her. She accused them of seeking media attention through abuse, said "enough is enough," and slammed Baba Ramdev for allegedly making derogatory comments about women while invoking "Sanatan Dharm."

title: ‘You don't know what happened’: After Maha cliff tragedy, aunt rejects iPhone claim
content: The aunt of a deceased teenager has released an emotional video pleading for an end to unverified claims. She stated that false narratives about the family's tragedy are circulating widely on social media. The family is already struggling with immense grief and distress from the recent deaths. She appealed to social media users to consider the family left behind before posting.

title: Who is Kaziah Liz Mejo? Meet the 19-year-old Miss Universe India 2026
content: Kaziah Liz Mejo, a 19-year-old law student and model from Kerala, has won the Miss Universe India 2026 crown in Jaipur. The Mavelikkara native, who grew up in Abu Dhabi, has a strong background in academics, classical dance, music and acting. She will represent India at the 75th Miss Universe pageant in Puerto Rico in November.

title: Dhruv shines like a jewel in Colombo; makes the opportunity(ies) count
content: With his place under pressure and Sarfaraz Khan breathing down his neck, Dhruv Jurel delivered when India needed him most. His hard-earned hundred in Colombo could be the knock that turns a make-or-break series into a career-defining one. India declared their first innings at 503 for 9 as only 53 overs were possible on Day 2.

title: Peg of doubt: Is your whisky really what the label says?
content: Indian regulators are increasing scrutiny of alcoholic beverage manufacturers.  The FSSAI is investigating alleged violations involving flavor additives and age claims.  This action focuses on flavors used to mimic natural spirit characteristics.  Consumers are urged to pay closer attention to product labels and disclosures.  The FSSAI's move highlights growing concerns about product authenticity and transparency.

title: ‘Have kids reached home?’ Rain leaves school buses stranded for hours across Gurgaon
content: Heavy rain in Gurgaon caused school buses and vans to become stuck. Many children remained inside their vehicles for hours due to severe waterlogging. Parents experienced significant anxiety as they could not reach their stranded children. Some children arrived home wet and cold after prolonged delays. The incident highlighted the vulnerability of school transport during intense rainfall.

title: Delhi-NCR rain chaos: Capital under orange alert; WFH advisory issued for Gurgaon
content: Heavy rains lashed Delhi-NCR on Monday, causing significant waterlogging and traffic congestion. Authorities in Gurgaon issued a work-from-home advisory for August 25 due to the downpour. Several key roads and underpasses in Delhi also experienced severe water accumulation. Flight operations were disrupted, with fifteen Delhi-bound flights being diverted. Civic teams were deployed to manage the situation and clear waterlogged areas.

title: Mumbai Marathi rule protest: Auto driver beaten, passengers dragged out amid outcry
content: An autorickshaw driver faced assault from protesters opposing the Marathi language proficiency drive. Demonstrations occurred in several Mumbai locations, including Kandivali and Malad West. Some protesters disrupted services and forced passengers to deboard their vehicles. Misinformation about fines fueled panic among drivers unable to speak Marathi. The situation normalized later in the day after police intervention.

title: US is building a fortress around China. Its shrinking missile stocks could be the weak link
content: The United States faces a critical precision weapon shortage.  This deficit impacts its ability to deter Chinese aggression in the Pacific.  Current global conflicts have depleted American military stockpiles significantly.  The US is now accelerating production and adopting new strategies.  This aims to counter China's growing military capabilities effectively.

title: Ukraine marks 4th I-Day amid war: How drones & defiance stopped Russia’s war machine
content: Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine has entered its fifth year.  The conflict has devolved into trench warfare, resembling the First World War.  Both sides face immense human and financial costs in this attritional struggle.  Ukraine's adaptability and Western support sustain its defenses against Russian advances.  This prolonged war tests endurance and reshapes Europe's security order.

title: Putin credits PM Modi for growing Russia-India trade in talks with EAM Jaishankar
content: Russian President Vladimir Putin acknowledged Prime Minister Narendra Modi's role in strengthening bilateral ties.  He noted that trade turnover between Russia and India has significantly increased this year.  External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar conveyed good wishes and discussed economic cooperation details.  Both leaders anticipate future meetings at upcoming international summits.  The India-Russia partnership demonstrates resilience and adaptability amidst global complexities.

title: UP man marries 2nd time for son, kills wife after child’s birth

The victim had left her first husband and married the accused, facing family opposition initially. Tensions escalated after the accused refused to accept her daughter from her first marriage.

title: Trump tightens Iran squeeze, hurting China and India in the process
